items.title: Corning (GLW) Dropped, So What Is Behind The Latest Attention?
items.summary: Corning (GLW) has moved back into focus after announcing a US$2b at the market follow on equity offering, just as AI related shares experience wider volatility and investors reassess capital raising plans. items.title: Verizon Communications (VZ) Added Nine Members To Its 6G Forum
items.summary: Verizon Communications (NYSE:VZ) expanded its 6G Innovation Forum, adding nine new industry participants, according to its latest announcement. items.title: Is Verizon Stock Counting On Money That Has Not Arrived Yet?
items.summary: Verizon Communications (VZ) has had a good year. The stock returned about 24% over the past twelve months against roughly 19% for the S&P 500, and at about $51 it sits at the top of its one-year range. The turnaround is real. What is not real yet is the revenue meant to pay for it.

items.title: 3 High-Yield Dividend Stocks That Let You Sleep at Night
items.summary: Some dividend stocks beg you to watch them constantly, but a rare few are built so that checking in once a quarter feels like more than enough. Three names across pipeline infrastructure, wireless telecom, and net-lease real estate are making a strong case for that second category.

items.title: Can AST SpaceMobile's Expanding MNO Base Boost Its Revenue Prospects?

items.title: How Much You Need Invested to Cover Your Medicare Premiums With Dividend Income
items.summary: Your Medicare premium leaves your Social Security check before you ever see it, but the right dividend portfolio changes that equation permanently. The tricky part is knowing exactly how much capital your specific income bracket demands.
